Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Jayvardhan Kandpal, learned counsel for the
petitioner, through video conferencing.
2. This contempt petition has been filed under Section
12 of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 alleging willful
and deliberate contempt of Writ Court's order dated
23.03.2026, passed in WPSB No.160 of 2026, Dr. Dwariak
Prasad Vs. Gurukul Kangri University and another,
whereby on the statement given by the learned counsel for
the respondent-University, the writ petition was disposed
of.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent-University before
the Writ Court has submitted that the result could be
open as there was no impediment for not declaring the
result, which was lying in a sealed cover and the same
would be produced before the Board of Management in
the meeting scheduled on 24.03.2026 where the result
would be duly notified.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner
that despite the said undertaking given by learned
counsel for the respondent-University in the presence of
Deputy Registrar of the University the order of the Writ
Court has not been complied with.
5. According to learned counsel for the petitioner, this

2
is contempt of this Court's order dated 20.03.2026.
6. Issue notice to the respondents-contemnors
returnable within four weeks.
7. Steps to be taken within three days.
8. List this case on 11.09.2026.
9. In the meantime, respondents-contemnors may file
response or comply with the order.
